en.introduction: Turn current topics, stories and real-world roles into short, achievable speaking challenges.
en.worldsIntro: Speaking has a purpose when there is something interesting to think about.
en.rolesIntro: A role gives the learner an audience and a reason to speak.
en.feedbackIntro: Read this fictional mini-story aloud. On the second try, keep the words and pause before the final sentence.
en.practiceOpening: My red kite went higher than the trees.
en.practiceEnding: I felt proud because I kept trying.
en.example: “Your example helped me picture the scene. Try pausing before your last sentence so I can hear why it matters.”
en.retry: The learner says the same words again, adding one pause before the final sentence. The listener notices what changed.
en.decideIntro: Share their grade, speaking experience and any event they are preparing for. Kai can discuss whether this course or another coaching format is a suitable fit.

zh-CN.introduction: 把时事话题、故事和真实生活中的角色，变成简短、可尝试的表达挑战。
zh-CN.worldsIntro: 有了值得思考的内容，表达就有了目的。
zh-CN.rolesIntro: 角色让学生知道自己在对谁说话，以及为什么要表达。
zh-CN.feedbackIntro: 试着把这个虚构的小故事读出来。第二次使用同样的话，在最后一句前停顿一下。
zh-CN.practiceOpening: 我的红风筝飞得比树还高。
zh-CN.practiceEnding: 我很自豪，因为我一直在尝试。
zh-CN.example: “你的例子让我想象出了那个场景。试着在最后一句前停顿一下，让我听清它为什么重要。”
zh-CN.retry: 学生用同样的话再试一次，在最后一句前加一处停顿。听众观察这次有什么变化。
zh-CN.decideIntro: 请说明孩子的年级、表达经验，以及正在准备的演讲或展示。Kai 可以与你讨论这门课程或其他辅导形式是否合适。

editorialNote: V18 extends the published course narrative with an original fictional kite story and a written pause cue. Existing coach feedback retained; both displays reuse the same opening and ending. EF China and Cambridge children activity pages inform bounded practice context, not outcome claims. English/Chinese meaning reviewed by the agent; no independent parent translation study. Numerical scope remains in the shared programme model.
